[[File:FFT Half MP.png|right|thumb|250px|Half MP in effect. Here, Bahamut costs 30 MP where normally he costs 60 MP to cast.]]
{{Quote|Halves MP usage in battle.|''[[Final Fantasy Dimensions]]'' description}}
'''Half MP''', also known as '''Half of MP''', '''Half MP Cost''' {{J|消費MP半減|Shōhi MP Hangen}}, '''Mental Discipline''', or '''MP Efficiency''', is a recurring [[support ability]] that reduces [[MP (stat)|MP]] cost by half. In some games, MP costs can be [[One MP Cost|reduced to one]] using a similar ability. It is generally granted by the [[Gold Hairpin]] and [[Luminous Robe]].

{{See|One MP Cost|Spellspring|Magic Efficiency Materia}}

==Appearances==
===''[[Final Fantasy IV]]''===
MP Efficiency would have been an [[Augment (Final Fantasy IV)|Augment ability]] in the 3D version, but was [[Dummied content|dummied out]] for an unknown reason. The only thing that can be found is a text description found within the data.

===''[[Final Fantasy V]]''===
The headgear [[Gold Hairpin (Final Fantasy V)|Gold Hairpin]] cuts MP cost in half during [[Battle (term)|battle]]. It can be found in [[Pyramid of Moore]] and [[Barrier Tower]], and [[Steal (Final Fantasy V)|stolen]] from [[Famed Mimic Gogo]].

===''[[Final Fantasy VI]]''===
The [[Gold Hairpin (Final Fantasy VI)|Gold Hairpin]] relic cuts MP cost in half. It can be found in [[Narshe]] (by saving [[Lone Wolf the Pickpocket]] instead of [[Mog (Final Fantasy VI)|Mog]]), [[Mt. Zozo]], and the [[Ancient Castle (Final Fantasy VI)|Ancient Castle]]. They can also be obtained through the [[Dragon's Neck Coliseum]] by betting the [[Crystal Orb (Final Fantasy VI)|Crystal Orb]], [[Dragon Horn (Final Fantasy VI)|Dragon Horn]], or [[Ribbon (Final Fantasy VI)|Ribbon]].

===''[[Final Fantasy IX]]''===
{{Main|Half MP (Final Fantasy IX)}}
Half MP is a [[Final Fantasy IX support abilities|support ability]] learned by [[Vivi (Final Fantasy IX party member)|Vivi]], [[Dagger (Final Fantasy IX gameplay)|Dagger]], [[Quina (Final Fantasy IX party member)|Quina]], and [[Eiko (Final Fantasy IX party member)|Eiko]]. It halves MP costs during battle. It is learned from the [[Add-on (Final Fantasy IX)|Add-on]] [[Protect Ring (Final Fantasy IX)|Protect Ring]] and from the [[Light Robe (Final Fantasy IX)|Light Robe]]. Mastering Half MP requires 140 AP for Vivi, 125 AP for Dagger, 90 AP for Quina, and 120 AP for Eiko. Eleven [[Magic Stone (Final Fantasy IX)|Magic Stones]] are required to equip it.

===''[[Final Fantasy X]]''===
{{Main|Half MP Cost (Final Fantasy X)}}
Half MP Cost is an auto-ability for weapons that halves MP costs. It can be customized to a weapon by using [[Twin Stars (Final Fantasy X)|Twin Star]] x20. Half MP Cost weapons [[item drop#Final Fantasy X|drop]] from [[Adamantoise (Final Fantasy X)|Adamantoise]] and [[Sanctuary Keeper]]. Its upgrade is [[One MP Cost (Final Fantasy X)|One MP Cost]].

====''[[Final Fantasy X-2]]''====
The [[Gold Hairpin (Final Fantasy X-2)|Gold Hairpin]] accessory and [[Font of Power]] [[Garment Grid]] grants the wearer [[Half MP Cost (Final Fantasy X-2)|Half MP Cost]].

===''[[Final Fantasy XI]]''===
The [[Scholar (Final Fantasy XI)|Scholar]] job has two [[Scholar (Final Fantasy XI)#Strategems|Strategems]] that reduce the MP costs of certain types of magic by half.

====Penury====
Penury is only available while under the effect of [[Light Arts]]. It reduces the MP cost of the next white magic spell cast by 50%. It is learned by a Scholar at level 10. Its recast Time is a Stratagem Charge.It lasts for 1 white magic spell or 60 seconds, whichever occurs first. The 50% reduction in MP cost does not stack with the 10% reduction from Light Arts, meaning that the spell costs 50% of the normal MP cost rather than the Scholar's reduced MP cost from casting in the proper art. [[Conserve MP]] can still activate while Penury is in effect.

====Parsimony====
Parsimony is only available while under the effect of [[Dark Arts (Final Fantasy XI)|Dark Arts]]. It reduces the MP cost of the next black magic spell cast by 50%. It can be learned by a Scholar at level 10. Its recast time is a Stratagem Charge. It lasts for 1 black magic spell or 60 seconds, whichever occurs first. The 50% reduction in MP cost does not stack with the 10% reduction from Dark Arts, meaning that the spell costs 50% of the normal MP cost rather than the Scholar's reduced MP cost from casting in the proper art. [[Conserve MP]] can still activate while Parsimony is in effect.

===''[[Final Fantasy XII]]''===
The [[Sage's Ring (Final Fantasy XII)|Sage Ring]] cuts MP cost in half. One can be found in [[Great Crystal (Final Fantasy XII)|Great Crystal]] (only with [[Diamond Armlet (Final Fantasy XII)|Diamond Armlet]]) and it is also a reward in the [[Hunt Club|Rare Game Hunt Club]] if the player gives the most trophies to Stok. In addition, the Channeling [[Augments (Final Fantasy XII)|augments]] permanently reduces MP cost by 10% of the default value.

===''[[Final Fantasy XIV]]''===
{{Quote|Reduces MP cost of next attack spell by half, and restores MP when spell is cast.|Description}}
{{Ability section|Final Fantasy XIV}}

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics]]''===
{{Main|Halve MP (Tactics)}}
Halve MP (also known as Half of MP) is a [[Final Fantasy Tactics support abilities|support ability]] learned from the [[Summoner (Tactics)|summoner]] job for 900 JP. All actions that require MP for this unit will have their costs halved.

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''===
{{Quote|Cuts the amount of MP used for abilities by half.|Description}}
[[Half MP (Tactics Advance)|Half MP]] is learned by the [[Summoner (Tactics Advance)|Summoner]], [[Illusionist (Tactics Advance)|Illusionist]], and [[Bishop (Tactics Advance)|Bishop]] classes through the [[Luminous Robe|Light Robe]] for 300 AP. It cuts the MP cost of the user's skills by half.

====''[[Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift]]''====
Halve MP is learned by the [[Summoner (Tactics A2)|Summoner]], [[Illusionist (Tactics A2)|Illusionist]], and [[Bishop (Tactics A2)|Bishop]] classes through the [[Luminous Robe (Tactics A2)|Luminous Robe]] for 400 AP. It halves the MP cost of the user's skills.

===''[[Final Fantasy Dimensions]]''===
[[Mental Discipline (Dimensions)|Mental Discipline]] is the final ability of the [[White Mage (Dimensions)|White Mage]] class, requiring 450 AP to learn. It requires 2 slots in order to use. Mental Discipline only stays in effect during battle, and reduces the cost of all skills that use MP by half, including [[Magic (term)|Magic]], Class Skills and even [[Fusion Ability|Fusion Abilities]].

==Etymology==
Parsimony means extreme or excessive economy or frugality, or stinginess. It implies conservation for the sake of prosperity.

Penury means extreme poverty, destitution, scarcity, or insufficiency. It implies conservation out of necessity.
